name: Wearable peripheral neuromodulation for migraine and pain (Cefaly, Nerivio, Relivion/Proliv, Quell)
founders: Pierre Rigaux and Pierre-Yves Muller (Cefaly / STX-Med SPRL, Liège, Belgium, founded 2004)
Alon Ironi, Ronen Jashek, Shimon Eckhouse (Theranica / Nerivio; Slava Barabash listed by one source); trials led by David Yarnitsky
Shmuel Shany and Amit Dar (Neurolief Ltd; Relivion, Proliv Rx)
Shai Gozani (NeuroMetrix, founded 1996 / Quell; NeuroMetrix now an electroCore subsidiary)
founded_year_range: 2004-2022: STX-Med/Cefaly company founded 2004 (European sales from c.2009); NeuroMetrix 1996; FDA De Novo DEN120019 for Cefaly 11 Mar 2014; Quell cleared as Ascend K140333 3 Jul 2014, Quell K152954 Jan 2016; Theranica founded 2016 (some sources 2015), Nerivio De Novo DEN180059 20 May 2019; Relivion 510(k) K203419 16 Feb 2021; Quell-FM De Novo DEN210046 18 May 2022
cost_summary: Relivion: verified US$200 non-refundable 60-day program fee, then cash purchase 'as low as' $900 (site pricing as of Mar 2026). Nerivio: Rx only via specialty pharmacy or telehealth, 18 x 45-min treatments per unit, no public price, insurance or copay support. Cefaly: OTC and HSA/FSA eligible; Cefaly Connected $509 plus electrodes $28-36 per 3-pack (US store, Oct 2026). Quell: OTC Quell (historically about $249 starter kit plus about $30/month electrodes) appears discontinued; Quell Fibromyalgia is Rx with no public price.
mechanism_summary: Peripheral nerve stimulation is said to engage central pain-modulatory circuits. Nerivio's upper-arm Remote Electrical Neuromodulation is claimed to trigger conditioned pain modulation (brainstem descending inhibition releasing noradrenaline and serotonin). A company review frames deficient CPM as shared by 'certain idiopathic pain disorders', which is partly transdiagnostic. Cefaly stimulates supraorbital/supratrochlear trigeminal branches to desensitize the trigeminal system. Relivion (and Neurolief's Proliv Rx for depression) stimulates occipital and trigeminal branches together, targeting the trigemino-cervical complex and brainstem. Quell uses high-frequency calf TENS, invoking gate control, endogenous opioids and descending inhibition against central sensitization in fibromyalgia. Each device is cleared condition by condition, and none offers a psychological illness model.
roots: diffuse noxious inhibitory controls / conditioned pain modulation
techniques: external trigeminal (supraorbital) nerve stimulation, 60 min acute / 20 min daily preventive
remote electrical neuromodulation of the upper arm, 45 min at attack onset or every other day for prevention
combined occipital-trigeminal stimulation headset, 20-60 min (max 80 min/day)
Nerivio GIER guided imagery/education/relaxation module in app
mainstream_notes: All are FDA-authorized. The Cefaly De Novo (2014) was the first migraine device, followed by 6 Cefaly 510(k)s through 2024. Nerivio has 7 FDA actions (De Novo plus 6 510(k)s, 2019-2025) and is now indicated for ages 8+, acute and preventive. Quell-FM De Novo 2022 for fibromyalgia. Neuromodulation devices are named among options in the 2021 American Headache Society consensus statement. Prescribed in US headache centres. Available to US veterans (VA real-world cohort published 2026); No public DoD/TRICARE coverage policy found. Neurolief's Proliv Rx received FDA PMA (P250010) for adjunctive MDD treatment on 31 Dec 2025. Fibromyalgia use is niche.
insurance_notes: Nerivio says it is 'eligible for insurance coverage', varying by plan, with a copay/support program; DC Medicaid became the first Medicaid plan to cover it (May 2024), and Theranica reported about 130 million covered US lives by Dec 2025, mostly BCBS plans. The VA covers Relivion per its site, and Nerivio for veterans. Relivion's commercial coverage is not available. Cefaly is OTC and HSA/FSA eligible, mostly out of pocket.

key_trials.finding: 50% pain reduction in 64% vs 26% with sham; earlier treatment more effective

key_trials.finding: 2-h pain relief 66.7% vs 38.8%; pain-free 37.4% vs 18.4%; MBS relief 46.3% vs 22.2%

key_trials.finding: Monthly migraine days -4.0 vs -1.3 (gain 2.7); significant in both episodic and chronic subgroups

key_trials.finding: 2-h pain-free 41.7% vs 20%; >=50% pain reduction at 2 h 52% vs 17%; sponsor-authored

key_trials.finding: Pooled 2-h pain relief 64%, pain-free 22%; double-arm OR for 2-h pain-free 2.77 (95% CI 1.63-4.71)

key_trials.citation: Canales-Rodriguez J et al. Eur J Neurol 2026
key_trials.design: Independent systematic review of 70 non-invasive neuromodulation trials for migraine/cluster headache
key_trials.finding: Acute trials mostly sham-controlled and blinded, but endpoints often departed from IHS guidelines and preventive trials were heterogeneous; more robust sham-controlled studies needed

controversy: Nearly all trials are manufacturer-funded with company co-authors; independent replication is scarce. Sham blinding is hard and sham response rates are high (about 37-55% 2-h relief). Pain-freedom gains are modest (7% absolute in TEAM). There are no head-to-head trials against triptans or gepants, and an independent 2026 systematic review notes heterogeneous, guideline-nonadherent endpoints. Quell-FM was authorized despite a null primary endpoint, with marked unblinding. Marketing language ('normalizes the brain's electrical activity') outruns the mechanistic evidence, and CPM engagement by REN is inferred rather than shown in patients. Rx and specialty-pharmacy channels and disposable units create recurring costs. Neurolief's Proliv Rx was FDA-approved (PMA) for adjunctive depression treatment on the basis of a single sponsor trial (MOOD, N=124).

Cefaly units sold in Europe since 2009

popularity.reach_estimate: Roughly 10^5-10^6 cumulative users across all four brands (highly uncertain). Basis: about 10^4 users in published REN real-world datasets, a 2,313-user Cefaly survey, and sales of Cefaly in Europe and the US since about 2009-2014. Company figures: >50,000 US Nerivio users, ~80,000 Cefaly units sold in Europe, ~130M covered lives for Nerivio.
popularity.method_notes: Trajectory is anchored on FDA decision dates verified via openFDA (Cefaly 2014-2024, Quell 2014/2016/2022, Nerivio 2019-2025, Relivion 2021), on REN publication counts in Europe PMC (accelerating from 2019), and on the 2013 PREMICE/2014 FDA media spike for Cefaly. The 2009 Cefaly European launch is an estimate. Reddit activity comes from a Wayback capture because the live Reddit JSON returned 403. Company user counts are company-reported. Google Trends was not checked. Reach is an order-of-magnitude estimate.
